star.enchant_by_doing.miner_start.name: Heart of the Mountain
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_start.desc: Each level grants +1% pickaxe mining speed. Base mining speed penalty is reduced.
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node2.name: Coal Seam
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node2.desc:
10% chance (+5% per 25 levels) to receive 1-3 extra coal when mining any ore.
Requires Miner Level: 25
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node3.name: Hearty Miner
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node3.desc:
15% chance to restore 0.5 saturation (1 food point) when mining ore.
Requires Miner Level: 50
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node4.name: Diamond Rush
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node4.desc:
Mining diamond ore grants Haste I, Speed I, and Night Vision I for 20 seconds. Effects stack.
Requires Miner Level: 75
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node5.name: Ancient Trace
star.enchant_by_doing.miner_node5.desc:
2% chance to discover Ancient Debris when mining Nether Gold Ore.
Requires Miner Level: 100
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_start.name: Battle Inspiration
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_start.desc: Each level increases sword damage dealt by +1%.
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node2.name: Marauder
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node2.desc:
20% chance to receive double loot when slaying a mob.
Requires Warrior Level: 20
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node3.name: Bastion
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node3.desc:
When holding a shield in off-hand, 20% chance to completely negate incoming damage (costs 10 shield durability, 5s cooldown).
Requires Warrior Level: 40
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node4.name: Nether Reverence
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node4.desc:
Piglins remain neutral even without golden armor. Negative effect durations on you are reduced by 25% (50% at level 80).
Requires Warrior Level: 60
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node5.name: Blood Frenzy
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node5.desc:
20% chance on killing a hostile mob to restore 2 HP. If at full health, grants 2 HP Absorption (caps at 10 HP / 5 hearts).
Requires Warrior Level: 80
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node6.name: Second Wind
star.enchant_by_doing.warrior_node6.desc:
Defies lethal damage, granting 10 Absorption hearts, Regeneration V, Speed III, Strength III, and Blindness I for 3s (5m cooldown). Endermen flee and teleport when looked at.
Requires Warrior Level: 100
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_start.name: Eagle Eye
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_start.desc: Each level increases projectile damage by +1%.
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node2.name: Arrow Scavenger
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node2.desc:
25% chance to not consume arrows when firing (50% at level 75).
Requires Hunter Level: 25
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node3.name: Quickdraw
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node3.desc:
+25% bow draw speed and crossbow charge speed (+50% at level 100).
Requires Hunter Level: 50
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node4.name: Toxic Sting
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node4.desc:
Tipped arrow potion effect durations are doubled.
Requires Hunter Level: 75
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node5.name: Supersonic Barrage
star.enchant_by_doing.hunter_node5.desc:
+50% projectile velocity. Holding right-click automatically fires bows and crossbows continuously.
Requires Hunter Level: 100
star.enchant_by_doing.lumberjack_start.d: Each level increases axe woodcutting speed by +1% and axe damage by +1%.
star.enchant_by_doing.lumberjack_node2.d:
Automatically plants a sapling from your inventory when a tree is felled.
Requires Lumberjack Level: 20
star.enchant_by_doing.lumberjack_node3.d:
10x increased apple drop rates when breaking leaves or felling trees.
Requires Lumberjack Level: 40
star.enchant_by_doing.lumberjack_node4.d:
+25% axe attack speed. Leaves break instantly when hit with an axe.
Requires Lumberjack Level: 60
star.enchant_by_doing.lumberjack_node5.d:
Axes do not lose durability. Dual-wielding axes triggers rapid alternating strikes, +50% chopping speed, and alternating arm animations.
Requires Lumberjack Level: 80
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_start.name: Gift of Fertility
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_start.desc: Each level increases farming efficiency by +1% and adds +0.1% chance to harvest gilded crops.
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node2.name: Golden Grain
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node2.desc:
Allows harvesting Luminous Straw. Breeding cows and sheep yields 2-4 offspring and instantly matures baby animals when fed.
Requires Farmer Level: 25
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node3.name: Glistering Refreshment
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node3.desc:
Allows harvesting Glistering Melons. Eating them instantly restores 2 hearts (4 HP).
Requires Farmer Level: 50
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node4.name: Auric Tuber
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node4.desc:
Allows harvesting Auric Tubers. Eating one shrinks player height to 1 block for 10s. Used for brewing Shrinking potions.
Requires Farmer Level: 75
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node5.name: Gilded Root
star.enchant_by_doing.farmer_node5.desc:
Allows harvesting Gilded Beets. Eating one clears all potion effects (like milk) while consuming 3 food bars.
Requires Farmer Level: 100
star.enchant_by_doing.enchanter_start.de: Reduces material costs when enchanting (from +25% at lvl 1 down to -75% at lvl 100).
star.enchant_by_doing.enchanter_node2.de:
Returns an empty book when learning enchantments or combining in anvils. Items are not damaged when removing enchantments.
Requires Enchanter Level: 25
star.enchant_by_doing.enchanter_node3.de:
Disenchanting at a grindstone has a 15% chance to preserve an enchantment into a book. Increases item enchantment capacity by +1.
Requires Enchanter Level: 50
star.enchant_by_doing.enchanter_node4.de:
Potion effect durations increased by 50% (+100% at lvl 100), drink speed doubled. Drinking hurls the empty glass bottle as a projectile dealing 6 damage.
Requires Enchanter Level: 75
star.enchant_by_doing.enchanter_node5.de:
Increases maximum enchantment capacity on all items by an additional +1 (total +2 above vanilla limit).
Requires Enchanter Level: 100
item.minecraft.splash_potion.effect.stro: Splash Potion of Experience Surge II
item.minecraft.lingering_potion.effect.s: Lingering Potion of Experience Surge II

workstation.enchant_by_doing.enchanting_: Required for diamond/netherite gear and magical artifacts.
workstation.enchant_by_doing.fletching_t: Required for crafting bows, crossbows, and arrows.
